errors.text_span: 此图表以饼图形式呈现结构音节组配对的数据，并通过切片显示不同类别之间的比例。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly implies there is only one pie chart. The figure clearly shows two related pie charts, where the right chart is a breakdown of a slice from the left chart.
The figure contains a total of four slices across two charts, not six slices in one chart.
The largest slice in the figure, representing 69.39%, is yellow, not blue. The blue slice is the smaller one in the left-hand chart.
The percentage for the slice labeled “单音形容词+单音名词” is 69.39%, not 39.34%.

errors.text_span: 紧随其后的切片是亮黄色，标注为“双音形容词+单音名词 101例, 30.61%”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the color and label. The label “双音形容词+单音名词 101例, 30.61%” corresponds to the blue slice, not the yellow one.
The label on the orange slice is '“的”字只隐不現' (the character '的' is only hidden, not appearing), not '“的”字只显现' (the character '的' only appears).
After describing three slices (incorrectly), there is only one slice remaining in the figure, not three.
The label on the green slice is '“的”字只现不隐' (the character '的' is only appearing, not hidden), not '“的”字只隐现' (the character '的' is only hidden).

The description completely misses the most important structural feature of the figure: that it is a cascaded or exploded pie chart where the second chart on the right is a detailed breakdown of the largest slice from the first chart on the left, as indicated by the connecting lines.
